title: Mouse holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='28' rx='14' ry='17' fill='#ff4466'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='22' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ff8899' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M72 45 Q70 50 68 55' stroke='#ffcc44' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M70 44 L72 45 L74 44' fill='#ff4466'/>
  
  <!-- Mouse body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='72' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#8899bb'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='74' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#aabbdd'/>
  
  <!-- Mouse head -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='56' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#8899bb'/>
  
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='46' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#8899bb'/>
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='46' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ffaa88'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='44' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#8899bb'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='44' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ffaa88'/>
  
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='54' r='2.5' fill='#222233'/>

  <circle cx='43' cy='53' r='2.5' fill='#222233'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='52.5' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='60' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff8899'/>
  
  <!-- Whiskers -->
  <line x1='26' y1='59' x2='18' y2='56' stroke='#ccddff' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='26' y1='62' x2='17' y2='63' stroke='#ccddff' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='58' x2='58' y2='55' stroke='#ccddff' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='61' x2='59' y2='62' stroke='#ccddff' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M36 63 Q38 65 40 63' stroke='#ff8899' stroke-width='0.8' fill='none'/>
  
  <!-- Arm holding string -->
  <path d='M52 68 Q60 60 66 54' stroke='#8899bb' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='54' r='3' fill='#aabbdd'/>
  
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='86' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#ffaa88'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='86' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#ffaa88'/>
  
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M29 76 Q18 80 15 72 Q13 66 20 67' stroke='#ffaa88' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
